name: Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be of full age and capacity (18 years or older, of sound mind).
Requires 12 months' continuous residence immediately preceding the application (the Minister may allow this period to end up to 6 months before the application).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 12 months' continuous residence immediately preceding application.

requirements.blocker_text: Within the 7 years before that 12-month period, requires an aggregate of not less than 5 years of residence or government service (the Minister may count earlier periods or accept less for special circumstances).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of residence or government service within the antecedent 7-year window.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires good character and adequate knowledge of the English language.
Must intend to reside in Grenada, or to enter or continue in Government service.

evidence_required.document: Oath of Allegiance (aliens and British protected persons)

sources.title: Grenada Citizenship Act, Cap 54, Section 7 (primary legislation): Naturalisation -- 12 months' immediate residence plus an aggregate 5-of-7-years antecedent residence/government-service requirement, good character, English language knowledge, intent to reside/serve, oath of allegiance for aliens/British protected persons, ministerial discretion for special circumstances (Section 7(3), subject to parliamentary approval) including expedited paths for former citizens, political refugees, and stateless persons

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Grenada's initial build. Unlike Saint Lucia's ambiguous antecedent-period wording, Grenada's primary Act text is explicit: 'not less than five years' aggregate residence or service within the 7-year antecedent window -- a clean, confirmed 5-of-7 figure (modelled at 60 months, the confirmed floor). No renunciation-of-other-citizenship requirement was found in the fetched Section 7 text (unlike Saint Lucia's naturalisation route) -- dual_citizenship_allowed left null rather than assumed true or false, since this was not explicitly confirmed either way. Section 7(3)'s special-circumstances regulations (1978) provide additional, less-documented expedited paths for former Grenadian citizens, political refugees, and stateless persons requiring only 'good character' with no stated residence duration -- not modelled as separate routes in this build since no further criteria were found, but flagged as a known gap; the stateless/political-refugee variant in particular may be worth a closer look given Grenada's separate international_protection.json route in this build.
